verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust/Axum web framework, and frameworks can plausibly ship background jobs, schedulers, or autonomous automations, so this axis applies. The evidence pack has no background task, cron, job queue, or autonomous-automation capability. Its agent material (AGENTS.md, llms-full.txt, Markdown docs routes) helps coding agents author code; it does not run automations in the background.
